claims: Transfuse packed red blood cells for symptomatic anemia with hemoglobin 7.7 g/dL and hematocrit 23.6%.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings (tidal volume ~500 mL, PEEP 5 cmH2O) and monitor airway pressures and minute ventilation.
Recheck hemoglobin/hematocrit and coagulation panel (PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen) to assess bleeding risk and response to transfusion.
Monitor lactate trend to assess resolution of tissue hypoperfusion (lactate 2.8-3.5 mmol/L).
Continue invasive hemodynamic monitoring via pulmonary artery catheter and arterial line, including cardiac output and CVP.
Continue temporary pacemaker with backup pacing and monitor rhythm, sensing, and capture thresholds.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin infusion per protocol for glycemic control.
Assess and manage pain with multimodal analgesia, including opioid and non-opioid agents as ordered.
Perform ventilator-associated pneumonia prevention bundle: subglottic suctioning, oral care, and head-of-bed elevation.
Provide stress ulcer prophylaxis and venous thromboembolism prophylaxis as indicated.
